Description: Quantitative acceptance criteria for AI components: ISO 21448 Cl.6.5 establishes the framework but defers quantitative values to context, and no published method derives application-specific targets for an AI component
Partial Coverage: ISO 26262-5 Cl.8 (SPFM >= 99%, LFM >= 90%) and Cl.9 (PMHF < 10^-8 h^-1), ASIL D, hardware only; ISO 21448 Cl.6.5 (establishes the acceptance-criteria framework, including risk tolerability principles, but defers quantitative values to context); ISO/IEC TR 5469 Cl.9.2.2 (non-separability acknowledged)

Description: Over-the-air (OTA) re-assurance workflow (partial coverage): no single standard prescribes the complete re-assurance workflow for a modified AI model
Partial Coverage: ISO 26262-8 Cl.8 (change management, assumes conventional software); ISO/PAS 8800 Cl.14.8.3 (does not define when partial re-assurance is sufficient); ISO 24089 (software update engineering; specifies the update process, not re-assurance of a modified AI model's argument); ISO/IEC TR 5469 Table A.8 (change protocols, informative only)

Description: Adversarial-SOTIF boundary unowned: adversarial inputs that exploit functional insufficiencies fall between G7 and G8 without belonging to either
Partial Coverage: ISO 21448 Cl.1 (explicitly excludes cybersecurity threats); ISO/SAE 21434 Cl.15 (includes threat scenarios such as LiDAR spoofing)

Description: No cross-domain release decision criteria: a component can satisfy each standard individually, yet no standard requires evaluating the combined residual risk across domains
Partial Coverage: ISO 26262-2 Cl.6.4.8 (the encompassing system safety case collects the per-domain assessments but does not define how their residual risks combine into one release decision); ISO/SAE 21434 Cl.3.1.11 (cybersecurity case); ISO 21448 Cl.12 (evaluation of the achievement of SOTIF; release recommendation)

Description: Data acceptance criteria for AI components: ISO/PAS 8800 Cl.8.4 prescribes data quality requirements but defers thresholds to context, and no published method derives an application-specific threshold
Partial Coverage: ISO/PAS 8800 Cl.8.4, Annex B G3 (prescribes data quality requirements as a framework, but defers thresholds to context); ISO/IEC TR 5469 Cl.9.3.2 (data linked to HARA, informative); ISO/IEC TR 5469 Cl.9.3.3 (four criteria, informative)
